theorem.name: OakVerification.Text.checkText_sound
theorem.claim: Text acceptance implies unsatisfiability of the database returned by parseDIMACS.

additional_local_validation.change: Replace any prior gate report with passed=false before validating a new attempt.
additional_local_validation.test: Start with passed=true and an unsuccessful suite report; script exits nonzero and replaces the gate report with passed=false.

artifacts: The opt-in workflow retains original solver artifacts and build/lean-gate records, input SHA-256 hashes, checker outputs and corruptions for 30 days.
limits: The theorem refers to decoded DIMACS semantics; format-preservation of the parser remains unproved.
Go-to-Lean refinement and source-to-CNF semantic preservation remain unproved.
The gate is opt-in CI/developer tooling; the normal Go verifier has no Lean runtime dependency.
RAT and theory lemmas are unsupported.
